name: ATLAS-W Action Helm — Drive + Fire
scope: Seven new product files under atlas_w_action/live. No original fleet, CORE, Y13, HUMANS, multiplayer, workflow, deployment configuration or prior immutable URL changed.

tests.scope: Local Node execution. Actual Three scene objects and unchanged Vessel with synthetic DOM/event interfaces; no browser or GPU.

controls.W_ArrowUp: Starts engines and progressively adds ahead power
controls.S_ArrowDown: Reduces current power, then applies reverse thrust; retains inertia
controls.Space_Fire: Quick press fires immediately when ready; hold repeats after cooldown
controls.touch: Left driving pad and right Fire control available together; multiple independent pointers

implemented: No separate firing mode: sail, steer and shoot simultaneously
Optional game trajectory aim assist enabled by default; manual aiming remains available
Short key and pointer presses no longer depend on catching a rendered frame
Clear held inputs on pause, blur, cancellation, resizing and menu entry
Drive input and projectile updates consume existing fixed host steps
Each projectile inherits its own evaluated muzzle and vessel-velocity contribution
Moving-target relative sweeps and sampled water collision
Time-smoothed chase camera and numeric portrait/landscape target-framing checks
Turret slew, barrel recoil, muzzle flash and tracer effects
Bounded expanding game fire, rising smoke, fragments, splash spray, rings and flash lighting
Practice targets tilt and sink after a hit
Optional synthesized firing/impact sound with distance attenuation
verificationLimits: Actual rendered browser, GPU shader compilation, native touchscreen, physical iPhone, Safari and audio output not verified
Public hosting URL could not be read from this environment; source publication is confirmed, public delivery is not
Earlier blocked browser automation was not retried or moved to another route; no new browser or CI run
No measured frame-rate, battery, optical latency or smoothness gain
simulationLimits: Fictional game physics, not calibrated naval weapons or real explosives engineering
Original ship coefficients and both vessel dynamics modules unchanged
Recoil animates turret barrels, not a ship-dynamics impulse
Simplified practice-target/water impacts, no general ship/land damage solver
Inherited ship, ocean and terrain are not a new photorealistic rebuild
Existing long-render interruption pause remains; native Resume may be required
No crew contacts, submarine or multiplayer adoption
